Motor puro (embebido — mismo contrato que EQG_Motor_Puro.zip)\nimport json, math, copy\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple\nimport numpy as np\n\nOUT = Path(\"outputs_eval_motor\")\nOUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\nRNG = np.random.default_rng(42)\n\n# ----- channels -----\nclass Regime(str, Enum):\n    ESTABLE = \"ESTABLE\"\n    INESTABLE = \"INESTABLE\"\n    CONFLICTO = \"CONFLICTO\"\n\nclass CausalRole(str, Enum):\n    CAUSA_DIRECTA = \"CAUSA_DIRECTA\"\n    INDICADOR = \"INDICADOR\"\n    COMBINACION = \"COMBINACION\"\n    NULO = \"NULO\"\n\nclass Intervention(str, Enum):\n    HOLD = \"HOLD\"\n    REMAP = \"REMAP\"\n    DD_CONDITIONAL = \"DD_CONDITIONAL\"\n    DD_ALWAYS = \"DD_ALWAYS\"\n    PHASE_VZ = \"PHASE_VZ\"\n\n@dataclass\nclass EyesChannel:\n    friction: float\n    smoothed: float\n    regime: Regime\n    firma_dsp: List[float]\n    health: Dict[int, float]\n    candidates: List[int]\n    def to_dict(self):\n        d = asdict(self); d[\"regime\"] = self.regime.value; return d\n\n@dataclass\nclass ReflexesChannel:\n    selected: List[int]\n    score: float\n    edges_avoided: int\n    def to_dict(self):\n        return asdict(self)\n\n@dataclass\nclass JudgmentChannel:\n    role: CausalRole\n    intervention: Intervention\n    target_qubits: List[int]\n    expected_gain: float\n    reason: str\n    do_candidate: float\n    do_latent: float\n    def to_dict(self):\n        d = asdict(self); d[\"role\"] = self.role.value; d[\"intervention\"] = self.intervention.value; return d\n\n@dataclass\nclass HandsChannel:\n    dd_applied: bool\n    sequence: str\n    phase_vz: float\n    probe_state: str\n    layout: List[int]\n    def to_dict(self):\n        return asdict(self)\n\n@dataclass\nclass ObservableChannel:\n    h_ideal: float\n    h_real: float\n    his: float\n    se_his: float\n    def to_dict(self):\n        return asdict(self)\n\n@dataclass\nclass MotorState:\n    cycle: int\n    eyes: EyesChannel\n    reflexes: ReflexesChannel\n    judgment: JudgmentChannel\n    hands: HandsChannel\n    observable: ObservableChannel\n    meta: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    def to_dict(self):\n        return {\"cycle\": self.cycle, \"eyes\": self.eyes.to_dict(), \"reflexes\": self.reflexes.to_dict(),\n                \"judgment\": self.judgment.to_dict(), \"hands\": self.hands.to_dict(),\n                \"observable\": self.observable.to_dict(), \"meta\": self.meta}\n\nprint(\"channels OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":1},{"id":"51d2de3f-6632-4deb-97dd-a3b655bfc2a8","cell_type":"code","source":"# ----- eyes / reflexes / judgment / hands / observable / runtime -----\nclass DSPProfiler:\n    def fit(self, samples):\n        x = np.asarray(samples, float)\n        if x.size < 2:\n            return [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0]\n        c, b = float(np.std(x)), float(np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(x))))\n        g = float(np.max(x) - np.min(x))\n        a = float(1.0 / (1.0 + c + b))\n        return [c, b, g, a]\n\nclass AOMMembrane:\n    def __init__(self, capacity=12):\n        self.capacity = capacity\n        self.buf = []\n        self.state = Regime.ESTABLE\n    def update(self, friction):\n        self.buf.append(float(friction))\n        if len(self.buf) > self.capacity:\n            self.buf.pop(0)\n        sm = float(np.mean(self.buf))\n        if self.state == Regime.ESTABLE:\n            if sm >= 0.55: self.state = Regime.INESTABLE\n            if sm >= 0.72: self.state = Regime.CONFLICTO\n        elif self.state == Regime.INESTABLE:\n            if sm >= 0.72: self.state = Regime.CONFLICTO\n            elif sm < 0.35: self.state = Regime.ESTABLE\n        else:\n            if sm < 0.58: self.state = Regime.INESTABLE\n        return self.state, sm\n\nclass Eyes:\n    def __init__(self, n, thr=0.92, hist_n=12, seed=0):\n        self.n, self.thr = n, thr\n        self.dsp, self.aom = DSPProfiler(), AOMMembrane(hist_n)\n        self.rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n        self._hist = []\n    def _friction(self, t1=None, t2=None, readout=None, detuning=None, gate2q=None):\n        health, frics = {}, []\n        for q in range(self.n):\n            f = 0.0\n            if t2 and q in t2: f += max(0.0, 1.0 - float(t2[q])/150.0)*0.35\n            if t1 and q in t1: f += max(0.0, 1.0 - float(t1[q])/100.0)*0.15\n            if readout and q in readout: f += min(1.0, float(readout[q])/0.05)*0.25\n            if detuning and q in detuning: f += min(1.0, abs(float(detuning[q]))/30.0)*0.10\n            if gate2q and q in gate2q: f += min(1.0, float(gate2q[q])/0.02)*0.15\n            if not any([t1, t2, readout, detuning, gate2q]):\n                f = float(self.rng.uniform(0.02, 0.12))\n            f = float(np.clip(f, 0, 1))\n            health[q] = float(np.clip(1-f, 0, 1)); frics.append(f)\n        return float(np.mean(frics)), health\n    def observe(self, t1=None, t2=None, readout=None, detuning=None, gate2q=None):\n        friction, health = self._friction(t1, t2, readout, detuning, gate2q)\n        self._hist.append(friction)\n        if len(self._hist) > 32: self._hist.pop(0)\n        firma = self.dsp.fit(self._hist)\n        self.aom.capacity = max(4, int(8 + 8*firma[3]))\n        regime, smoothed = self.aom.update(friction)\n        cands = sorted(health, key=lambda q: health[q], reverse=True)\n        return EyesChannel(friction, smoothed, regime, firma, health, cands)\n\nclass Reflexes:\n    def __init__(self, n_logical): self.n_logical = n_logical\n    def select(self, eyes, coupling_map=None):\n        ranked = list(eyes.candidates) or list(range(self.n_logical))\n        edges = set()\n        if coupling_map:\n            for a,b in coupling_map: edges.add((min(a,b), max(a,b)))\n        selected, forbidden, avoided = [], set(), 0\n        for q in ranked:\n            if q in forbidden: avoided += 1; continue\n            selected.append(q)\n            for a,b in edges:\n                if a==q: forbidden.add(b)\n                elif b==q: forbidden.add(a)\n            if len(selected) >= self.n_logical: break\n        for q in ranked:\n            if len(selected) >= self.n_logical: break\n            if q not in selected: selected.append(q)\n        selected = selected[:self.n_logical]\n        score = float(np.mean([eyes.health.get(q,0) for q in selected])) if selected else 0.0\n        return ReflexesChannel(selected, score, avoided)\n\nROLE_THRESHOLD = 0.20\ndef _classify_role(ec, ez, thr=ROLE_THRESHOLD):\n    c, z = abs(ec)>=thr, abs(ez)>=thr\n    if c and z: return CausalRole.COMBINACION\n    if c: return CausalRole.CAUSA_DIRECTA\n    if z: return CausalRole.INDICADOR\n    return CausalRole.NULO\n\nclass Judgment:\n    def __init__(self, health_thr=0.92): self.health_thr = health_thr\n    def decide(self, eyes, morph):\n        do_a = max(0.0, self.health_thr - morph.score)*0.5\n        do_z = eyes.friction*0.8\n        if eyes.regime == Regime.CONFLICTO: do_z += 0.25\n        elif eyes.regime == Regime.INESTABLE: do_z += 0.12\n        role = _classify_role(do_a, do_z)\n        if eyes.regime == Regime.ESTABLE and morph.score >= self.health_thr:\n            return JudgmentChannel(role, Intervention.HOLD, list(morph.selected), 0.0, \"estable_hold\", do_a, do_z)\n        if role == CausalRole.INDICADOR or eyes.regime == Regime.CONFLICTO:\n            return JudgmentChannel(role, Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL, list(morph.selected), float(do_z), \"latent_dd_conditional\", do_a, do_z)\n        if role in (CausalRole.CAUSA_DIRECTA, CausalRole.COMBINACION):\n            if do_a >= do_z:\n                return JudgmentChannel(role, Intervention.REMAP, list(morph.selected), float(do_a), \"candidate_remap\", do_a, do_z)\n            return JudgmentChannel(role, Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL, list(morph.selected), float(do_z), \"combined_dd\", do_a, do_z)\n        return JudgmentChannel(role, Intervention.REMAP, list(morph.selected), float(max(do_a, do_z)), \"default_remap\", do_a, do_z)\n\nclass Hands:\n    def __init__(self, default_seq=\"CPMG\"): self.default_seq = default_seq\n    def act(self, judgment, detuning=None, probe_label=None):\n        dd = judgment.intervention in (Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL, Intervention.DD_ALWAYS)\n        seq = self.default_seq if dd else \"NONE\"\n        phase = 0.0\n        if detuning and judgment.target_qubits:\n            vals = [float(detuning.get(q,0)) for q in judgment.target_qubits]\n            phase = float(sum(vals)/len(vals))*1e-3\n        if probe_label is None:\n            probe_label = \"degraded\" if dd else \"stable\"\n        return HandsChannel(dd, seq, phase, probe_label, list(judgment.target_qubits))\n\ndef HIS(hid, hre, eps=1e-8):\n    d = abs(hid)\n    return float(\"nan\") if d < eps else 1.0 - abs(hid-hre)/d\n\nclass EQGMotor:\n    def __init__(self, n=8, health_thr=0.92, seed=0, coupling_map=None):\n        self.n = n\n        self.coupling_map = list(coupling_map) if coupling_map else [(i,i+1) for i in range(n-1)]\n        self.eyes = Eyes(n, thr=health_thr, seed=seed)\n        self.reflexes = Reflexes(n)\n        self.judgment = Judgment(health_thr)\n        self.hands = Hands()\n        self.cycle = 0\n    def step(self, t1=None, t2=None, readout=None, detuning=None, gate2q=None,\n             h_ideal=1.0, h_real=None, se_h=0.0, probe_label=None):\n        e = self.eyes.observe(t1, t2, readout, detuning, gate2q)\n        r = self.reflexes.select(e, self.coupling_map)\n        j = self.judgment.decide(e, r)\n        h = self.hands.act(j, detuning, probe_label)\n        if h_real is None:\n            protect = 0.85 if h.dd_applied else 1.0\n            h_real = h_ideal * (1.0 - min(0.95, e.friction * protect))\n        obs = ObservableChannel(h_ideal, float(h_real), HIS(h_ideal, float(h_real)),\n                                (se_h/abs(h_ideal)) if abs(h_ideal)>1e-8 else float(\"nan\"))\n        st = MotorState(self.cycle, e, r, j, h, obs)\n        self.cycle += 1\n        return st\n\nprint(\"motor OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:06:20.428990Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:06:20.429977Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:06:20.467301Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:06:20.429946Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:06:20.465761Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"motor OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":2},{"id":"c79f7acd-dbfa-4b67-a1a6-3cb1e7e7c4a0","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 1. Escenario de evaluación\n\n- N=8, path coupling\n- 30 ciclos con **deriva TLS**: T2* de un subconjunto de qubits cae 150→40 µs\n- Hilo **baseline**: sin motor (fricción cruda → HIS)\n- Hilo **EQG**: bucle completo con canales\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"e54b4787-7d55-4dac-8474-9531d52de938","cell_type":"code","source":"CONFIG = {\n    \"n\": 8,\n    \"n_cycles\": 30,\n    \"h_ideal\": 1.5,\n    \"his_floor\": 0.15,\n    \"drift_qubits\": [1, 3, 5, 6],  # qubits que degradan (TLS)\n}\n\ndef signals(cycle: int) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Señales públicas tipo Centinela — visibles sin privilegios.\"\"\"\n    n = CONFIG[\"n\"]\n    # T2*: buenos ~155, degradados caen con el ciclo\n    t2 = {}\n    for q in range(n):\n        if q in CONFIG[\"drift_qubits\"]:\n            t2[q] = max(25.0, 155.0 - 4.5 * cycle)\n        else:\n            t2[q] = 150.0 + RNG.normal(0, 3)\n    t1 = {q: max(30.0, 0.7 * t2[q] + RNG.normal(0, 2)) for q in range(n)}\n    readout = {q: 0.01 + (0.03 if q in CONFIG[\"drift_qubits\"] else 0.0) * (cycle/CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"])\n               for q in range(n)}\n    detuning = {q: (-27.0 if t2[q] > 100 else -22.0) + RNG.normal(0, 0.3) for q in range(n)}\n    gate2q = {q: 0.006 + (0.01 if q in CONFIG[\"drift_qubits\"] else 0.0) * (cycle/20)\n              for q in range(n)}\n    return {\"t1\": t1, \"t2\": t2, \"readout\": readout, \"detuning\": detuning, \"gate2q\": gate2q}\n\n# baseline HIS: sin EQG — solo fricción media de señales\ndef baseline_his(sig, h_ideal):\n    frics = []\n    for q in range(CONFIG[\"n\"]):\n        f = max(0.0, 1.0 - sig[\"t2\"][q]/150.0)*0.35\n        f += min(1.0, sig[\"readout\"][q]/0.05)*0.25\n        frics.append(f)\n    friction = float(np.mean(frics))\n    h_real = h_ideal * (1.0 - min(0.95, friction))\n    return HIS(h_ideal, h_real), friction\n\nmotor = EQGMotor(n=CONFIG[\"n\"], seed=7)\nhist_eqg, hist_base = [], []\nbreak_eqg = break_base = None\n\nfor c in range(CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"]):\n    sig = signals(c)\n    st = motor.step(**sig, h_ideal=CONFIG[\"h_ideal\"])\n    hb, fb = baseline_his(sig, CONFIG[\"h_ideal\"])\n    hist_eqg.append(st.to_dict())\n    hist_base.append({\"cycle\": c, \"HIS\": hb, \"friction\": fb})\n    if break_base is None and hb <= CONFIG[\"his_floor\"]:\n        break_base = c\n    if break_eqg is None and st.observable.his <= CONFIG[\"his_floor\"]:\n        break_eqg = c\n    if c % 5 == 0 or c == CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"]-1:\n        print(\"c=%02d  base_HIS=%.3f  eqg_HIS=%.3f  regime=%s  int=%s  dd=%s  layout=%s\" % (\n            c, hb, st.observable.his, st.eyes.regime.value,\n            st.judgment.intervention.value, st.hands.dd_applied, st.reflexes.selected[:4]))\n\nprint(\"\\nbreak_base=%s  break_eqg=%s  extra=%s\" % (\n    break_base, break_eqg,\n    None if break_base is None else (\n        (break_eqg - break_base) if break_eqg is not None else CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"]-break_base)))\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:06:20.468857Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:06:20.469305Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:06:20.509467Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:06:20.469277Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:06:20.508512Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"c=00  base_HIS=0.949  eqg_HIS=0.814  regime=ESTABLE  int=REMAP  dd=False  layout=[1, 6, 4, 0]\nc=05  base_HIS=0.916  eqg_HIS=0.766  regime=ESTABLE  int=REMAP  dd=False  layout=[2, 7, 4, 0]\nc=10  base_HIS=0.878  eqg_HIS=0.751  regime=ESTABLE  int=DD_CONDITIONAL  dd=True  layout=[4, 0, 2, 7]\nc=15  base_HIS=0.838  eqg_HIS=0.707  regime=ESTABLE  int=DD_CONDITIONAL  dd=True  layout=[0, 4, 7, 2]\nc=20  base_HIS=0.800  eqg_HIS=0.656  regime=ESTABLE  int=DD_CONDITIONAL  dd=True  layout=[4, 2, 0, 7]\nc=25  base_HIS=0.760  eqg_HIS=0.605  regime=ESTABLE  int=DD_CONDITIONAL  dd=True  layout=[2, 0, 4, 7]\nc=29  base_HIS=0.727  eqg_HIS=0.571  regime=ESTABLE  int=DD_CONDITIONAL  dd=True  layout=[4, 7, 2, 0]\n\nbreak_base=None  break_eqg=None  extra=None\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":3},{"id":"ae3beca9-0688-4a0a-8a94-233ea0995fa6","cell_type":"code","source":"# 2. Canales — no colapsar a una sola curva\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n\ncycles = list(range(CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"]))\nhis_b = [r[\"HIS\"] for r in hist_base]\nhis_e = [r[\"observable\"][\"his\"] for r in hist_eqg]\nfriction = [r[\"eyes\"][\"friction\"] for r in hist_eqg]\nmorph_sc = [r[\"reflexes\"][\"score\"] for r in hist_eqg]\ndo_z = [r[\"judgment\"][\"do_latent\"] for r in hist_eqg]\ndo_a = [r[\"judgment\"][\"do_candidate\"] for r in hist_eqg]\ndd_flag = [1.0 if r[\"hands\"][\"dd_applied\"] else 0.0 for r in hist_eqg]\nreg_map = {\"ESTABLE\": 0, \"INESTABLE\": 1, \"CONFLICTO\": 2}\nreg = [reg_map[r[\"eyes\"][\"regime\"]] for r in hist_eqg]\n\nfig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(11, 9), sharex=True)\n\nax = axes[0]\nax.plot(cycles, his_b, \"o-\", color=\"#c0392b\", label=\"Baseline (sin EQG)\", lw=2)\nax.plot(cycles, his_e, \"s-\", color=\"#27ae60\", label=\"EQG motor\", lw=2)\nax.axhline(CONFIG[\"his_floor\"], color=\"gray\", ls=\"--\", label=\"floor\")\nif break_base is not None: ax.axvline(break_base, color=\"#c0392b\", ls=\":\", alpha=0.7)\nif break_eqg is not None: ax.axvline(break_eqg, color=\"#27ae60\", ls=\":\", alpha=0.7)\nax.set_ylabel(\"HIS (salida)\")\nax.legend(loc=\"upper right\"); ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\nax.set_title(\"Evaluación motor EQG — N=%d, deriva TLS\" % CONFIG[\"n\"])\n\nax = axes[1]\nax.plot(cycles, friction, label=\"Ojos friction\")\nax.plot(cycles, morph_sc, label=\"MORPH score\")\nax.plot(cycles, do_z, label=\"Juicio do(Z)\")\nax.plot(cycles, do_a, label=\"Juicio do(A)\")\nax.set_ylabel(\"Canales internos\")\nax.legend(loc=\"upper right\", fontsize=8); ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n\nax = axes[2]\nax.step(cycles, reg, where=\"mid\", label=\"régimen 0=EST 1=INEST 2=CONF\")\nax.fill_between(cycles, 0, dd_flag, step=\"mid\", alpha=0.3, label=\"DD on\")\nax.set_ylabel(\"Régimen / DD\")\nax.set_xlabel(\"Ciclo\")\nax.legend(loc=\"upper right\", fontsize=8); ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n\nfig.tight_layout()\nfig_path = OUT / \"eqg_motor_eval.png\"\nfig.savefig(fig_path, dpi=140)\nprint(\"Figura:\", fig_path)\nplt.show()\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:06:20.511511Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:06:20.511984Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:06:21.547979Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:06:20.511928Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:06:21.547110Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Figura: outputs_eval_motor/eqg_motor_eval.png\n","output_type":"stream"},{"output_type":"display_data","data":{"text/plain":"<Figure size 1100x900 with 3 Axes>","image/png":"\n"},"metadata":{}}],"execution_count":4},{"id":"bb11119b-4f1e-407a-8fb2-228bef17f409","cell_type":"code","source":"# 3.
